package.name: messages
package.description: Vendored copy of the "messages" package used by the leggedrobotics navtech_radar_ros driver fork (byte-array-encoded RadarFftDataMessage / RadarConfigurationMessage, one uint8_t per scalar field, packed as network- order byte arrays). Kept wire-identical (same package name and .msg layout) so a subscription against that driver's topics type-matches. This is a DIFFERENT wire format from navtech_msgs (the official Navtech IA SDK messages, plain-typed fields) vendored alongside it in ros2/navtech_msgs - see radar.message_format in cfear_odometry_node.
